notes: New trained AI evaluator -- sharper decision-making across every skill tier.
AI now holds a Pilot for its real combo target instead of pairing onto whatever's on board, and won't discard a held Pilot at hand-limit either.

AI values digging for a combo piece via card draw, weighted by real deck odds -- never by peeking at what's actually drawn. Applies to every skill tier except Expert, which stays full-strength/unrestricted.
Fixed: team-wide "During Pair" auras (e.g. Gundam's AP+1) now update immediately instead of waiting for the next turn.
Fixed: replaying a game from a handicapped tournament match now reproduces the actual engine that played it.
Nu Gundam's AI handicap can now be bypassed ("Newtype Awakening") for anyone who wants to see the deck piloted at full, unrealistic strength.
New Settings screen: back up your saved decks, batch logs, and tournament results to a single zip file.
